# model training cutoff

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:modelTrainingCutoff`](gmeow-modelTrainingCutoff.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/modelTrainingCutoff>
- **Category:** property

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the training-data cutoff a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) declares — the staleness context against which every claim the model makes is read.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading it as the model's knowledge guarantee (it bounds, not certifies, currency) and avoid confusing it with an invocation's own [`gmeow:eventTime`](gmeow-eventTime.md) — the cutoff is a model property, the invocation time is the act's clock.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:modelTrainingCutoff`](gmeow-modelTrainingCutoff.md) as an [xsd:date](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date) on the [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md); downstream audits weigh it against a claim's subject recency.

### Examples

- ex:opusCard [`gmeow:modelTrainingCutoff`](gmeow-modelTrainingCutoff.md) "2026-01-01"^^[xsd:date.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date.)
